test_title: PYST 18: SSC CGL 2023 - English (Held On: 20 Jul 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.**

They live in the apartment __**above** __ours.
solution: The correct answer is **"Below."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"above"** means higher in position or rank, so the antonym would be a word that means lower in position or rank. (उच्‍चतर स्‍थान में; ऊपर) • **Example:** *The people in the flat **above**__ make a lot of noise.* • **"Below" **means at a lower level or position than something else. (किसी वस्‍तु या व्‍यक्ति से नीचे या निचले स्‍तर पर) __ • **Example: ***The temperature fell **below**__ freezing during the night.* • **"Below"** is the correct antonym of **"above."** • The correct answer is Option 4. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **"Over"** means above and covering, so it is not an antonym. (किसी वस्‍तु से सीधे ऊपर (उसे न छूते हुए)) • **"After"** means following in time or order, so it is not an antonym. (पश्‍चात; बाद में) • **"Upward"** means moving or directed towards a higher position, so it is not an antonym. (ऊपर की ओर जाने वाला या निर्देशित; ऊर्ध्वाभिमुख) 3c:Tb85, The correct answer is **"notable."**
